run_tool_loop: run a tool loop that calls an LLM, executes tool calls, and handles context compaction automatically
ToolLoopResult: create a ToolLoopResult dataclass to capture final text, messages, tool calls, token usage, and stop reason
ToolCallRecord: create a ToolCallRecord dataclass to store a single tool invocation name, arguments, result, and duration
truncate_error: truncate an error message to a configurable max length for safe logging
estimate_tokens: estimate the rough token count of a string using a 2.5 characters per token heuristic
